#### Complement of an event

The **complement** of an [event](#def-event) $A$, denoted $\neg A$,
is the event that $A$ does not [occur](#def-occurs):
the [set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/sets.html#def-set) of elements $\omega$ of the sample space $\samplespace$ that are not in $A$,
or equivalently,
the [set difference](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/sets.html#def-set-difference)
$\setdiff{\samplespace}{A}$:

$$
\ba
\neg A
&\eqdef \setbuild{\omega \in \samplespace}{\omega \notin A} \\
&= \setdiff{\samplespace}{A}
\ea
$$

:::
